 Kentucky vs. Grambling State game discussion and pregame reading
 Back at it tonight.
 by Ethan DeWitt Nov 16, 2026, 9:57 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Dylan Ballard - A Sea Of Blue Ethan DeWitt serves as an editor with us here at A Sea of Blue. The Kentucky Wildcats are back in action tonight as they welcome Grambling State to Rupp Arena. Game time is set for 7 PM ET on SEC Network, so another stream-only game for the Cats.
 It was a rough week for the Wildcats last week after getting smoked by Kansas and barely pulling off the win against Northern Arizona on Friday night. Similar to their last outing, they are once again 30-point favorites. Now, all we can hope is that it is better than what we last saw.
 To make improvements, the Cats really need to start to show some fight on the glass and on the defensive end of the floor. Their season to this point has been marked by those two things, and to have any chance of turning it around, it needs to start tonight.
 Can they do it is the question? You would like to think so.
 However, this week now becomes a very important one to help push forward the rest of this season. Come out tonight and barely scrape out a win, and things will not be pretty. Get a blowout win, and some people will start to buy back in, especially if they can knock off Indiana later this week.
 Should be an interesting one in Rupp tonight. Time for the Cats to try to get this train back on the tracks.
